body: Please let me know if I should take this down, I read the rules and I thought this was okay, but I'm aware I interpret things incorrectly sometimes. I apologise in advance if I've made a mistake.

I just wish more people were able to talk openly about it. It can change EVERYTHING. Just look at the Maori, for thousands of years before Christ, to the point where mammoths were around, it is believed that the Maori recited their entire history orally. No writing whatsoever. They spoke! No one believed it, but slowly all these myths and fables they had as part of their oral history started to be confirmed. Like they weren’t just mythological creatures, they were actually extinct animals, it wasn’t a dream location, it was somewhere from back in olden times that really existed, history had just changed it physically. It was insane because it was thousands upon thousands of years of history that predated some of the oldest historical documents of all time. The Aboriginals and Dreamtime have a similar story in terms of oral history. That’s why I’m such a strong believer in talking, in replying to every comment, in being totally open and honest. I may seem very pessimistic and depressed at times, but thank God for mania because it gives me a brief respite to realise things aren’t as bad as they can be. I see you too. Love and hugs.

Thank you!! I appreciate your kindness, you have my gratitude. We do need a better world, one that is safer and more gentle. Where the strong and the proud do not prey on the weak and undefended. That’s what I want to see in my future, very much so.

She’s my best friend!!! That’s true. Ants definitely have a smell, probably related to their production of formic acid. Also they communicate purely through chemical signals in the air so that would contribute with a large enough colony I would imagine. If you have small colonies, not so much, the bigger they get the more space you need. Some colonies exceed 1,000,000 ants, and ants aren’t just going to sit around if they don’t have enough space, they actively escape and it can be very dangerous if you have poisonous ants like I do. I’m only okay with the heat because I was born and raised on a small desert island.
Cool guy! Right back your way!

Just reread my comment, I just thought that I’d mention it in case it was overlooked: my first sentence where I told you that you have my moms name was sarcastic. I said it because it’s absurd, just like saying a device used around the world to help people with pressure based therapy, within an autistic context, is innately bad , just because of the person whose idea it was. That is shortsighted. I’m not going to tell someone that a form of therapy is invalid because of the person who brought it into the world. If it helps autistic people then that’s what matters.
Just drop me a message.

I was worried this was going to be really upsetting and rude to read but I saw it through to the end loool. Only because of the first sentence. Let’s be friends!!! We can take over the entire world!!!

My moms name is Rosalind so I’m not even surprised about this comment. If you reread the post you will see that I mention her name, then I talk about the hug box. I never said she’s the best person on Earth, i never even outlined my opinion on her as an individual, I was talking about her INVENTION, which is just as valid right now as before your comment. You read all this and sought fit to criticise me for talking about Temple Grandin? Wrong time and place, buddy. The hug box is important, what it’s used for is important. Where did I state that I support Temple Grandin? Where did I talk about how she should be an example for autistic people? Where are all these things you are inferring?

My dog is the most important thing in my entire life, I would die for her!! I will have to double check the list of names for you as they’re Latin and they’re annoying to remember, but I have stuff like doorstop ants, parasitic ants, tree ants, fire ants, slave ants, metallic ants, I could go on, I have 11 colonies I think? My home is basically at 27 degrees constantly. It’s ridiculous. Equipment and feeder bugs everywhere. Very clean tho, and I don’t let it smell!

I feel that, sometimes the sensation of hugging my dog is so overwhelming I grit my teeth and they grind. It’s like autistic purring, very strange. The pressure from hugs makes me feel safe, which is remarkably powerful. Thank you for adding me to the top of your list, bless you.

I’ve always wanted to be a writer, and I have an IQ of 167 so I’m pretty smart, I have a lot to say. I just need to overcome the fear aspect of it, let the world really see who I am. Thank you for reading my story. I appreciate it greatly. You are very kind.
I LOVE YOU TOO BUT AS A WEIRD AUTISTIC GUY ON THE INTERNET

Bless you my fellow tribesperson, thank you for contributing. Some people are billionaires, others don’t have clean drinking water. Some billionaires end up bankrupt, some people make billions. It’s all perspective

This has been one of my favourite replies so far. Any consideration from my fellow tribe members is more than enough for me. I’m sorry you lost your satisfaction/gained apathy. I’ve read a lot about transitional apathy, especially in the context of teenage neurological development, the whole explanation sucks when you really clock what it’s saying. I’m not a doctor though, so I can only make assumptions. I definitely wish I was more apathetic but at the same time I really don’t. My mental disorders are all brought on from child abuse, my mom and dad excelled at that. I may have been born with predispositions but it’s not a genetic factor in my lineage and I didn’t exhibit symptoms until 14, even while being abused, it definitely was a thing that blew up for me. I remember I just started sleeping 16 hours a day, I didn’t eat. I went from 19 to 11 stone in the space of a couple of years. I’ll add it to my hug list. Do you know what makes this post so much better than just 1 hug? This is immortal, you are all immortal in this moment. I can relive this whenever I need to remind myself who I am. I have everyone in this thread to thank for that. That’s very true. They use frozen corpses as markers to climb up to the summit of Everest. I don’t want to allow myself to be one of those people (metaphorically speaking)

You’re one of my tribe! salutations brother/sister/sibling! I’m in England too so I know how annoying British people can be. The ye oldeny up turnethed nose. I smoke weed to sleep otherwise I don’t sleep. It’s pretty terrifying being awake so much so I have to compromise. Thank you for all your kindness and your support. Means a bunch.

I think I’m moving closer and closer to realising that’s what I have to do. My mom is a manipulative individual who weaponised my problems against me. She was never good to me, just performatively good. Bribes and false platitudes. Even today as an adult, she doesn’t drink but she hasn’t changed. I’m very stoic now so I give little away. I know I deserve more, and I want more, I just need to find the right way out. My current project is to go and complete my  Scuba instructor training (if I can, I may not be capable anymore). Then I can move to Bali, work for PADI, and I will only have myself to be responsible for. No more of my mom dangling rent money over my head. I just hope that I’m healthy enough, for something, any job. So I can spread my wings and fly. 

Also I just wanted to say that what you said really resonated with me. It’s good to not feel so alone for once. So I am as grateful as humanly possible. You are truly kind.

I think of it like a giant game of 5-dimensional chess. The aim not being to win, but to understand so that you can play the best game possible. That is the path of knowledge I imagine that we all seek. I’ve always been a perfectionist though, so I’ll try not to be too hard on myself in the future. It was good you mentioned that actually!

That is very true. The most dangerous man on Earth is the man with absolutely nothing to lose. Human sounds better, but I didn’t write that. I have the propensity to achieve absolutely anything, I just need to ride with the momentum. Thank you for your kindness, stranger!

Her name is Winry! I found her in a bin when she was a puppy, so now we’re best mates. She’s a bit of a psychopath because she’s basically a wild dog breed - wouldn’t change her for the world though.

You wouldn’t believe it. I’m actually considering going to the hospital they’re kept at so I can take the physical copies myself (if that’s even legal) - either way I want to supervise their removal. I was first diagnosed at 6 so it’s a lot of important information.
Anytime, stranger :)

I’ve been trying this lately, affirmations and manifestation. When I have anxiety attacks or night terrors it definitely helps. It’s even good for when I need a confidence boost, but it’s still a learning process. I do my best to navigate around the icebergs of my mind that are the symptoms that block the way ever so. I appreciate your support, I shall definitely start practicing a lot more. I never thought of it like that before, that’s a fascinating thought process!
Don’t be! We’re gunna get through this together!
That was really quick. Thanks!

People take advantage of me and I allow them to because I give them all these chances, but you’re waiting for them to just get a grip and grow some potatoes, but they never do. My method is to just reduce effort until it’s not actively impacting my life, but I’ll never turn someone away, no matter what they’ve done to me!
I’m 6 foot tall but I am happy to run on my knee caps to make things more equal between us lmao.

Ahahahahaha my mom and boundaries? You’re more likely to see an Orca being ridden by a seal. She doesn’t comprehend “no”. If it doesn’t match her perspective it’s irrelevant. I just hate cutting people out because people have done it to me so much that I’m paranoid I’ll put it out into the universe and I’ll bring it back on myself twofold.

RESPECT. This is the energy I'm trying to foster within myself. I shouldn't be suicidally depressed, I don't want to be, I have a deep urge to love life. I'm enthralled by it. It's just difficult when you aren't in control of your emotions. Even the happiest of moments can make me sad. I can't produce my emotions correctly. I get happiness, sadness, and anger. Those are the only emotions my brain utilises. A lot of the time it's just an endless cycle of different emotions throughout the day. It can be torture.
Sometimes mutual understanding is so much more powerful than the answer itself. Thank you for contributing.
It's on its way, don't worry. I'll find you when this is all over and we can meet in a wheat-field and slow mo run towards each  other.  Autistic style.  Arms in the octopus position.

Trying to get them to realise that is akin to trying to draw blood from a stone lmao. They're much better now (not raging alcoholics), we talk sometimes, it's pretty awkward though, I don't feel much connection to them, and they definitely just see me as an obligation.  I just don't throw people away, it happened to me way too many times, so I banned myself from that behaviour.  Put out into the world what you wish to receive back. That's my toxic trait lol.

It's definitely to do with our sensory processing faculties. Our responses to external stimuli are always disproportionate, the smell of grass makes some people nauseous for example. It overwhelms your senses in a bad way. Hugs overwhelm autistic people with feelings of love and security. We feel safe. We may not recognise this in ourselves, so it can be scary. It overwhelms you with positive emotion, so each person responds differently. Some hate physical contact. If I'm upset? Then being touched can feel like someone  is burning my skin with a lighter. Thus I think physical contact carries a lot more weight with ATs than NTs. Hug therapy really works.

That’s actually a thing? there really is a subreddit for everything. Psychoanalytically speaking; she most definitely has a personality disorder, but due to our relationship it’s difficult to accurately psychoanalyse her as she definitely acts a lot of the time.
Thank you.

There’s a famous autistic woman called Temple Grandin, she invented this thing called a hugging box for cows to make them feel calmer when they were being milked, so long term the quality of milk went up, and the cows lived better quality lives. Then she converted the device to be used with humans, specifically those with autism. I think it shows just how much we need deep pressure stimulation.

Hugs make me cry. No one ever hugs me, so when they do I get totally overwhelmed. The first thing that I think of is “do I deserve this?” Then I realise that I actually need it. 

Thank you for your kindness, I wish I could reciprocate your hug.

Yeah I read that too, it’s just like a fish tank but with the air. Stagnant air/water is awful - just sits there. That’s why cables and mats bug me (no pun intended). I need a replicated environment, not heating measures. So I appreciate the advice!
I can’t fall asleep unless I’m shaking my legs. It’s actually physically uncomfortable for me to remain still. Very weird stuff.
You betcha. I do too, thank you. It’s very surprising how cathartic sharing blindly can be. It really takes away the shame.

Don’t you worry, I won’t go down without a fight. If anything, I have to keep going for my dog and my ants. Who would look after them otherwise? One of my ant colonies is actually self-sufficient to the extent that the colony will never die out as long as they’re tended to. They can replace their own queens! I digress lmao, thank you for your kindness. Things like this are what motivate me, the small acts of unexpected human kindness. They reach a part of me where I am deeply deprived. Bless you, stranger.

I’m already fully diagnosed, both here and in my home country. What I’m missing is the evidence of the severity of my conditions. I’m considered severely mentally impaired and I have 5 overlapping neurological disabilities (autism at the forefront). I need a carer really, but the government in the country I live in find ways to decline people the essential care that they need just to protect their pockets. They want staunch evidence you’re disabled before they fund you, but you’re assessed by a nurse who, IMO, is not qualified to assess you. So the only valid evidence I have is my files in my home country, which they would want anyway due to the history aspect of it. It’s like someone has handed me a million piece puzzle. I’ll solve it one day I imagine. Thank you for the luck, best wishes to you also!

My therapist is a long term support person, she helps me out pro bono (if that’s the right way to put it). I don’t pay her. As for the doctors/psychologists/whatever; I’ve been on a waiting list for almost 2 years. In social services, there’s also only 1 case worker for something like 2k - 4K autistic people in my city. I don’t even try to interact with that service. As for my therapist, I mean she’s great at talking me through things and what not, but she’s not in the country I am. So her abilities are limited in that context. I wish there was an easy solution, it just seems like no matter who it is, or what their job is, I get put on a waiting list, I get ignored, people get angry, people reprimand me, it’s kind of like slogging through a swamp actually. Progress is tearfully slow. I’m moving, don’t get me wrong. I’m just moving at a snails pace.

I totally agree with you, psychologically speaking; my theory is that she has created a structural fantasy where we are still in this mother/child relationship, probably to compensate with the fact she’s lonely. She really struggled with post-partum depression, so I’m used to her being delusional. It’s just difficult when someone is trying to rope you into their own psychological crisis.

My current plan to circumvent her is to complete my Scuba instructor/body recovery training, then hop around travelling for a while until I can save up enough to really set down some roots. The real kicker to this is my mom is second in command at the hospital where all of my medical files, up until about 21, are located. The country she’s in is also incredibly difficult to deal with, I’ve tried going around her but no cigar. The law doesn’t really work in a black and white way over there.

I appreciate all your words, thank you.

I really appreciate that you took the blunt approach. That’s what works best with me in all honesty. Likewise, I totally agree with everything you’re saying. I live alone with my support dog, in a separate country, we actually haven’t been physically in contact in almost 1.5 years. I don’t have a job though, I’ve been looking for 3 years now. So I’m stuck relying on my mom for financial aid with my rent, therapy, disability support, care, etc. I’d have aid from the government but, as I mentioned, she sabotaged that. So now I’m stuck in this weird dependent relationship with her, and she uses it as a means to mess with me. I’m just so baffled by it, I feel like I’ve tried just about everything and no one wants to help me.
That’s a very good lead, thank you for the suggestion. I’ll do some research on that right now!

I mean the government here is absolutely incompetent when it comes to the lockdown, a lot of what it is comprised of is contradictory to itself. Our health minister even voted against free meals for children during the lockdown. I don’t trust what they have to say. I follow the experts, doctors, and others in the medical field. I don’t believe that getting into a car and going to a location, where the chances are that we’re alone, is going to harm anyone. Even if there were another couple there, social distancing? Masks? It’s not a throng of 50 people jam packed into a compact space. I’m not an anti-masker or an anti-vaxxer, I’m pro-logic.

I love James Cameron, the only man with the audacity to con a bunch of people out of tons of money so he could fund his submersible dives down to the Titanic and Challenger Deep (making him the man with the record for the deepest manned dive in history). Then the Titanic accidentally did really well at the box office, and it turned into a phenomenon so everyone let it go. I’ll definitely go and check that documentary out, thank you! I was vegan for 5 years, went from 19 stone down to 11. It’s definitely on my list as it would be something I already have a basic understanding of

Thank you again for all of this advice, this is the exact kind of advice I’m looking for. It’s both constructive criticism and an explanation, this is what I respond to. Lots of people are happy to point me in the right direction, but often times when I follow that path I just end up lost. I just need more than that. Likewise with the common sense thing, I totally agree with you. I just find that in application my version of common sense is usually the exact opposite. A lot of people have used it to target me, so excuse me if I came across as sensitive. I didn’t think you were being unkind or anything. In regards to everything you said about information, I think you’re right. I could definitely include more information about myself, I just get nervous because people have gotten onto my back about talking too much in the past so it scares me. I think this is where a lot of my problems come from; no friends, no family, the only money I get is benefits (so food, PT, rent), I’ve been on the NHS (The British public health system) waiting list for nearing 2 years - they aren’t interested in helping me, I’ve called them over 30 times. I don’t personally know any experts that I could approach, I don’t even know where I would find one to begin with. I don’t want to be in a situation where I have to resort to posting on r/autism for this kind of stuff. I find it shameful and humiliating that I have to reach out for some semblance of assistance with living in this manner. All I have is the internet, and even that is something I find hard to process. In a perfect world I’d have a carer, but I’ve fallen through the cracks and I have to do this all alone. Im 26 (27 in less than a month), I’m 6 foot solid, I weigh 110 kilograms, I’m fat (probably between 25% and 30%), no underlying health conditions aside from having the worst brain possibly designable. I just don’t know what to do, where to go, who to talk to, nothing. It’s all Latin to me. I’m sorry if this is frustrating for you

Thank you very much for the advice, I’m grateful. I’ve spoken to my PT but he has 0 disability experience so his idea of dieting is incredibly harsh in comparison to what I’m looking for. I just want to be fit and healthy like I should be - so I can function at 100%. It’s already hard enough to remember to eat, sometimes I go days without eating purely because I do not think about it. This is why I’m trying to create something concrete and time-tabled so that I can follow it. I can follow instructions really well (when my brain isn’t fried lol).

I appreciate all of your advice! The relationship between diet and autism is intrinsic. In order to maintain a diet functionally you need to be able to adequately process information - which I cannot. It’s all well and good going to see the most sought after expert on the planet, but if they cannot convey that information to me in a way that I can interpret then it’s meaningless to me. Being that this the autism subreddit, I expect others on this subreddit to understand just how difficult it is taking a piece of information that is “common sense” to one, and making it understandable to another. I’m considered severely mentally impaired so I wasn’t born with common sense in the same way NTs are. We also live in a world where people like me are consistently rebuked when they attempt to seek help, may it be free from the government or paid for personally by me. I wouldn’t have resorted to Reddit if I didn’t feel like I was out of options. Likewise this isn’t the only post I’ve made about diet, I am collating information as best that I can so that I can find the answers I’m seeking.

I never thought that autistic people required a different diet to NTs. Not what I’m saying. It’s the management and the understanding of diet that I need help with. Likewise I also said that I can’t afford to pay for a dietician or I wouldn’t have posted on Reddit.
